text.es: El rey ha escuchado el total y ahora pregunta lo de siempre: «¿Y quién tiene qué?». Cinco aldeas, cinco alcaldes quejándose de que el vecino tiene más.
text.en: The king heard the total and now asks the usual question: “And who has what?” Five villages, five mayors complaining that the neighbour has more.
text.fr: Le roi a entendu le total et pose maintenant l’éternelle question : « Et qui a quoi ? » Cinq villages, cinq maires qui se plaignent que le voisin en a plus.

task.es: Para cada aldea (`village`) de `storehouses`, muestra su nombre y sus totales de `gold`, `wood` y `meat`, en ese orden.
task.en: For each `village` in `storehouses`, show its name and its total `gold`, `wood` and `meat`, in that order.
task.fr: Pour chaque village (`village`) de `storehouses`, affiche son nom et ses totaux de `gold`, `wood` et `meat`, dans cet ordre.

hints.es: Un `SUM` a secas lo mezcla todo en una fila. Necesitas que el Registro haga un montón por aldea antes de sumar.
hints.en: A plain `SUM` lumps everything into one row. You need the Registry to make one pile per village before adding up.
hints.fr: Un `SUM` tout seul mélange tout sur une ligne. Il faut que le Registre fasse un tas par village avant d’additionner.

hints.es: `GROUP BY columna`, después del `FROM`, crea un grupo por cada valor distinto. Los agregados se calculan entonces dentro de cada grupo.
hints.en: `GROUP BY column`, after the `FROM`, makes one group per distinct value. Aggregates are then computed within each group.
hints.fr: `GROUP BY colonne`, après le `FROM`, crée un groupe par valeur différente. Les agrégats sont alors calculés dans chaque groupe.

hints.es: Casi lo tienes: `SELECT village, SUM(gold), SUM(wood), SUM(meat) FROM storehouses GROUP BY ...;`
hints.en: Almost there: `SELECT village, SUM(gold), SUM(wood), SUM(meat) FROM storehouses GROUP BY ...;`
hints.fr: Tu y es presque : `SELECT village, SUM(gold), SUM(wood), SUM(meat) FROM storehouses GROUP BY ...;`

text.es: Stonewatch tiene trescientas cinco monedas y Bluebrook… treinta y cinco. Nuestra aldea era la más rica, y se lo llevaron todo de un solo sitio.
text.en: Stonewatch has three hundred and five coins and Bluebrook… thirty-five. Our village was the richest, and they took it all from one single place.
text.fr: Stonewatch a trois cent cinq pièces et Bluebrook… trente-cinq. Notre village était le plus riche, et ils ont tout pris à un seul endroit.

CREATE TABLE storehouses (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, village TEXT NOT NULL, gold INTEGER NOT NULL, wood INTEGER NOT NULL, meat INTEGER NOT NULL);

solution: SELECT village, SUM(gold), SUM(wood), SUM(meat) FROM storehouses GROUP BY village;

accepted: SELECT village, SUM(gold) AS gold, SUM(wood) AS wood, SUM(meat) AS meat FROM storehouses GROUP BY village ORDER BY village
